Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units. Source activities and compound_structures. Join activities to compound_structures on molregno. Filter by assay CHEMBL1613769, standard_value not null, and standard_relation equals '='. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
